class Solution:
    def hasSpecialSubstring(self, s: str, k: int) -> bool:
        n = len(s)
        # If the whole string is just one character repeated k times and surrounded by different characters
        # We can iterate over all substrings of length k and check the conditions.
        for i in range(n - k + 1):
            substring = s[i:i+k]
            # Check if all characters in substring are the same
            if not (len(set(substring)) == 1):
                continue
            char_in_sub = substring[0]
            # Check character before
            if i > 0 and s[i-1] == char_in_sub:
                continue
            # Check character after
            if i + k < n and s[i+k] == char_in_sub:
                continue
            # All conditions satisfied
            return True
        return False
